title: ID0413551 - DC/Si-D/NZ - [5nlchV, B6Y9TY] Not operational after FW update to 6.1.3 (C1)
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:  Charger is not operational after updating from version 6.0.3 → 6.1.3. Appears it is unable to download configuration from AWS and is not continuing to boot up. Logs attached.
Root cause: cofig corruption
Solution: Cfast card flashing
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:No
Warranty Status: Active
RC Contact-
Reisch, Ferdinand
